title: Number Tap Rush
description: Tap numbers 1 to 10 in order as fast as you can!
objective: Tap numbers 1-10 in correct order as quickly as possible
rules: Numbers 1-10 appear scattered randomly on the board
Tap them in order: 1, then 2, then 3, all the way to 10
A wrong tap adds a +2 second penalty to your time
Your final time is shown when you finish
Beat your personal best to earn the record bonus

title: Bubble Pop Math
description: Pop the bubble with the right answer! Subtraction problems (+ 3-step on Hard).
objective: Pop the bubble with the correct difference. Hard adds a third operand (a+b−c).
rules: A math problem (e.g., 3 + 4) shows at the top of the screen
Bubbles with different numbers float up from the bottom
Tap the bubble that shows the correct answer to pop it
Correct pop = +1 point and a new problem appears
Wrong pop = the bubble fizzles and a small shake animation plays

title: Make 10 Match
description: Tap two numbers that add up to 10!
objective: Find and tap all the number pairs that sum to 10
rules: A 4 by 4 grid is filled with numbers from 1 to 9
Tap one tile, then tap a second tile
If the two tiles add up to 10, they vanish with a sparkle
If they do not add to 10, both tiles flip back over briefly
Clear the whole board to finish the round

title: Speed Add
description: Add the numbers fast! Easy = 2 addends, Hard = 4 addends in a row.
objective: Pick the correct sum. Difficulty grows the chain: 2 → 3 → 4 addends.
rules: A problem like 5 + 3 appears in the middle of the screen
A number pad of 0 to 18 sits below the problem
Tap the correct answer to score a point and get a new problem
Wrong answers shake the pad but do not lose points
Your total correct is shown at the end

config.padLayout: 0-18 grid (4 wide x 5 tall, last row 3 wide)

title: Memory Numbers
description: Flip cards to match numbers with their words!
objective: Match every digit card with its matching number-word card
rules: 12 cards are placed face-down in a 4 by 3 grid
Tap a card to flip it, then tap a second card
Match a digit card (like 5) with its word card (like 'five') to keep both face up
Mismatched cards flip back after one second
Clear the whole board to win

title: Falling Numbers
description: Tap only the numbers that follow the rule before they fall off!
objective: Tap numbers that match the current rule and avoid the ones that do not
rules: A rule appears at the top, like 'Tap even numbers' or 'Tap numbers > 5'
Numbers from 1 to 20 fall slowly from the top of the screen
Tap matching numbers before they hit the ground for +1 point
Tap a wrong number = -1 point and a small shake
If a matching number falls off without being tapped = -1 point

title: Shape Sorter
description: Drag falling shapes into the right bucket!
objective: Sort shapes into their matching buckets as fast as you can
rules: Three buckets sit at the bottom: triangle, circle, and square
Shapes spawn at the top and slowly drift down
Drag each shape onto its matching bucket to score +1 point
Wrong bucket bounces the shape back with a soft buzz
Shape touches the ground = it disappears with no points

title: Counting Race
description: Count the items and tap the right number before time runs out!
objective: Count the items shown on screen and tap the correct total on the number pad
rules: A group of items (apples, stars, balloons) shows on the screen
You have 6 seconds to count them
Tap the matching number on the digit pad (0 to 20)
Correct = +1 point and a new group appears
Wrong or time-out = no points but the round keeps going

title: Tic Tac Toe
description: Classic 3-in-a-row — beat the computer!
objective: Win as many games as you can!
rules: You're X. The computer is O.
Tap a square to place your X.
First to get 3 in a row wins!
Score = how many games you win in 2 minutes.

title: Math Maze
description: Solve to step across the maze!
objective: Cross the maze — each step needs the right answer.
rules: Hakan starts at the left, needs to reach the right.
Each stone shows a math problem.
Tap the right answer to step forward.
Wrong answer? Step back one stone.
Cross the maze for +1 score, then a new one appears!

title: Math Snake
description: Eat the right answer to grow!
objective: Eat the correct answer to the math problem. Avoid walls!
rules: Use arrow buttons (or swipe) to steer the snake.
Each problem shows: eat the correct sum/difference.
Wrong food = no growth + small time penalty.
Hit a wall? Snake resets, time penalty.
Grow as long as you can!

title: Math Battle
description: Defeat the monster with math!
objective: Solve math problems to attack the monster!
rules: You and the monster each have HP.
Solve math correctly = attack the monster.
Wrong answer = monster attacks you.
Defeat the monster before time runs out!

title: Clock Quiz
description: Read the clock — what time is it?
objective: Pick the right time as fast as you can!
rules: A clock face shows the time.
Tap the right time from 3 options.
Wrong = 1s penalty.

title: Coin Counter
description: Count the coins — how much money?
objective: How many cents do you see?
rules: Coins appear: penny, nickel, dime, quarter.
Tap the total cents value.
Wrong = 1s penalty.

title: Place Value Builder
description: Build the number with tens & ones!
objective: Tap blocks to match the target number.
rules: A target number appears (like 47).
Tap ten-bars and one-blocks to build it.
First correct build scores!

title: Pattern Catcher
description: What number is missing in the pattern?
objective: Find the missing number fast!
rules: A sequence appears with one ? hole.
Tap the right number from 3 choices.
Wrong = 1s penalty.

title: Math Race
description: Race the CPU car! Solve math to zoom forward.
objective: Each correct math answer moves your car forward one step. CPU moves at a steady pace. Race to the finish line!
rules: 🏎️ YOU and 🚗 CPU start side by side at the left.
Solve a math problem to move forward one step.
CPU ticks forward every 3-5s depending on difficulty.
First to finish wins +5 💎.
Lose → rematch starts after 2.4s.

title: Dino Egg Hatch
description: Help dinosaur eggs hatch by solving math!
objective: Each egg has a number. Solve the math problem and tap the matching egg to hatch a baby dino.
rules: 🥚 eggs sit in a nest, each with a number.
Prompt: 'Find egg N + M' (or N − M).
Pick the right answer button → matching egg cracks open.
Hatch all eggs (4/5/7 by difficulty) to win +5 💎.

title: Rocket Launch
description: Fuel up the rocket and blast off!
objective: Each correct answer fuels the rocket. Reach 100% fuel to launch!
rules: 🚀 rocket sits on the launchpad, fuel at 0%.
Solve math problems to fill the fuel meter.
Each correct answer = +1 fuel tick (out of 5/8/10).
100% fuel → 3, 2, 1, LIFTOFF! Bonus +5 points.

title: Math Express
description: Build your train! Each correct answer adds a car.
objective: Solve math problems to add cars to your train. Build a 4/6/8-car train (easy/normal/hard) to win.
rules: 🚂 engine sits ready on the tracks.
A math problem appears. Tap the correct answer.
Each correct answer attaches a new car carrying that number.
Build the full train to win a +5 jackpot.

title: Color Math
description: Paint cells by solving math! Reveal the picture.
objective: Each cell holds a small number. Solve the math problem and tap a cell whose number matches the answer — that cell gets painted in. Fill the whole grid to reveal the picture!
rules: A math problem appears at the top with a color cue.
Solve it, then tap the matching cell on the grid.
Cells fill with color when painted.
Fill every cell to win a +5 jackpot bonus.

title: Math Fishing
description: Catch the fish whose number matches the answer!
objective: Read the math problem. Tap the swimming fish that shows the correct answer.
rules: A problem like '4 + 3' shows at the top.
Fish 🐟🐠🐡🦈 swim across the pond, each with a number on its side.
Tap the fish whose number is the answer.
Wrong fish = misses (no penalty fish, light penalty score).
Combo +2 points starting at 3 in a row.

title: Treasure Map
description: Hop across the math stones to reach the treasure!
objective: Hop from stone to stone by answering math problems. Reach the treasure chest!
rules: 🏴‍☠️ Pirate Hakan starts at the first stone.
Answer the math problem to hop forward one stone.
Wrong answer = pirate stays put (or steps back on Hard).
Reach the last stone to open the 💎 treasure chest (+5 bonus).

title: Number Garden
description: Grow a garden! Each correct answer makes a plant grow.
objective: Fill every plot with a fully-grown plant by solving math problems.
rules: A math problem appears at the top.
Pick the correct answer from 3 buttons.
Each correct answer grows the active plot one stage: 🌱 → 🌿 → 🌸 → bloom!
When a plot fully blooms it shows a flower or fruit and gives a +2 bonus.
Fill every plot to harvest the garden for a +5 jackpot.
